newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks edge up on foreign interest.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks edge up on foreign interest.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed slightly up on renewed foreign investors' interest, notably in market bellwether Electricidad de Caracas, traders said.
"Foreign investors were seen, and were especially active on Electricidad, and that mainly explains the rise," Inversiones y Valores broker Hector Perez said.
The bolsa's leading 19-share index closed up 0.29 percent to finish at 6,319.90 points.
Merinvest's composite index which includes telephone company CANTV, also rose 0.31 percent to close at 97.25 points.
Perez said Compania Anonima Electricidad de Caracas was particularly attractive because of widely expected rate rises in the near future.
Among traded issues, 17 fell, 16 rose and 10 closed flat.
Most traders saw Caracas stocks rising next week but some cautioned that a continuing absence of news could mean a certain lethargy.
